1.consolidated_definition: Diversión, alterne. Pasatiempo y disfrute en fiestas y actividades alegres. Neologismo anglicado, poco frecuente. Pase mis años de hangueo en discos y caserios donde se escuchaba hip hop y se bailaba dancehall, donde surgio el reguetón (indymediapr.org, 03-04-04)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Diversion, amusement. Pastime and enjoyment in festive events and joyful activities. Anglicized neologism, relatively infrequent. I spent my years of adolescence in hangouts and rural areas where hip hop was listened to and dancehall was danced, where reggaeton emerged (indymediapr.org, 03-04-04)
